thought.text: Ich mache jetzt die echte Reparatur. Lass mich zuerst die Persistenz-Instanziierung finden:

reasoning_content:
The user wants me to do a REAL fix, not just a bypass. Let me find:

1. Where persistence/database is originally instantiated in the project
2. Fix it properly so the world can actually save
3. Find the missing agent files and implement proper error counting logic

Let me investigate the codebase properly.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

print("=== 1. FINDE PERSISTENZ-INSTANZIIERUNG ===")

# Search for persistence instantiation patterns
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep -rn 'new PersistenceManager\\|new.*Persistence\\|PersistenceManager(' /opt/areloria/server/src --include='*.ts' 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -20")
print("Persistence creation:", stdout.read().decode())

# Search for database/backend patterns
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep -rn 'createPersistenceBackend\\|Database\\|postgres\\|firestore' /opt/areloria/server/src/core --include='*.ts' 2>/dev/null | head -15")
print("\nDB patterns:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
